email_body:
Dear Eureka Communications team,

I would like to apply for the Trainee in Communications position starting February 2027.

I am a digital marketer based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, working where content, SEO and the web meet. At Episto and through my own freelance practice, I write SEO content, manage WordPress sites, build and maintain pages for clients in consultancy, e-commerce and the non-profit sector, and report on results with Google Analytics and Search Console. English is my working language, Turkish is my native language, and I am learning Dutch.

What draws me to Eureka is the chance to watch communications do something concrete: promoting innovation beyond borders and knowing which message actually moved a project forward.

My CV is attached, and I would gladly talk about how I could support your team.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Eureka Communications team,

I am applying for the Trainee in Communications role starting February 2027. The traineeship is open to graduates from any discipline, so I will be straight about mine: I come from a technical and digital marketing background, and communications is where I have chosen to build my career.

At Episto and in my own freelance work, I spend my days on the things your team does. I write content meant to be found and read, publish and update pages in WordPress, and optimise sites so people actually reach them. For mirook.com I implemented structured data and an llms.txt file and ran repeated technical SEO audits that measurably improved the site's search health. For a pharmacists' association I keep a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages. For e-commerce clients I write and publish blog content and maintain their catalogues. I track all of it in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, and I hold Semrush SEO certifications alongside GA4, Google Ads Search and HubSpot Content Marketing certificates. Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I helped build SharePoint digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, which taught me how carefully structured content has to be when thousands of people depend on it.

Beyond that I work comfortably in Canva, use AI tools daily for research and drafting, and I am genuinely curious about the parts of this role I have not done yet: video production and speechwriting especially.

Eureka's work is international by definition. I am Turkish, work in English, and live in Belgium, so moving between languages and cultural expectations is ordinary for me, and I handle it with care.

I would welcome the chance to contribute to a team whose output has a visible impact, and to learn from colleagues who do this at a level I have not yet reached.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cv_highlights:
- Fluent English as a working language, native Turkish, Dutch in progress: comfortable working across languages and cultural contexts in an international team.
- Writing and publishing for the web: SEO blog and article content, website copy, and social media integration across consultancy, e-commerce and non-profit client sites.
- Content management systems in daily use: WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math, WooCommerce) and Shopify, including publishing, updating and maintaining large sets of pages and product content.
- SEO, GEO and reporting: on-page optimisation, keyword research, structured data, technical audits, and performance tracking in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs; Semrush SEO certifications plus GA4, Google Ads Search and HubSpot Content Marketing.
- Visual and technical toolset: Canva, plus daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, drafting and audits; team experience building SharePoint sites for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo and front-end work in JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
